summary: Alto Neuroscience, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 1.01 to report entry into an underwriting agreement for an underwritten registered direct offering of 3,776,436 shares of common stock at $26.48 per share, expected to close July 14, 2026. Net proceeds of ~$93.9M will fund clinical development of ALTO-207 and working capital. BofA Securities led the underwriters. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
